title: Extensions and workspace trust
summary: Extensions add editor features. Workspace Trust helps decide whether code in a folder may activate potentially risky features.
introduction: Extensions add editor features. Workspace Trust helps decide whether code in a folder may activate potentially risky features. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.title: Extensions and workspace trust

blocks.text: The decision is about the project source, not whether its icon looks familiar. Install only extensions you need from a trusted publisher.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: An extension can have significant access; avoid installing random ones for every tutorial.
